spans.s:
इति ind. A particle implying, 1. Cause, (thus, therefore.)
 2. Manifesta-
tion, (lo! behold!)
 3. Something additional, (etcetera.)
 4. The
meanings of एवम्^1, (so, thus, even, in this manner.)
 5. Conclusion,
enough, (finis.)
 6. Reference, (so says, this is, &c.) It also implies,
7. Order, arrangement, specific or distinctive, and 8. Identity
(of this or similar form.)
 9. A grammatical copulative, indicating a
preceding sound or sense, to be again intented.
 E. इ to go, क्तिच् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260703. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/285.

ईति f. (-तिः)
 1. Calamity of season, as drought, excessive rain, rats,
foreign invasion, &c.
 2. Travelling in foreign countries, sojourning.
3. An affray.
 E. ईङ् to go. affix क्तिन्.

इतिकथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
 1. Unworthy of trust, not fit to be credited.
 2.
Wicked, lost.
 f. (-था) Unmeaning or nonsensical discourse.
 E. इति
this, so, and कथा a saying.

इतिकर्त्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What is proper or necessary to be done. E.
इति so, कर्त्तव्य to be done.

इतिकर्त्तव्यता f. (-ता) Proper and right measures.
 E. इतिकर्त्तव्य with तल्
added, or with त्व, इतिकर्त्तव्यत्वं.

इतिह ind. Traditional instruction, advice, &c. mutually imparted. E.
इति so, thus, and ह tidings.

इतिहास m. (-सः) History, traditional accounts of former events, heroic
history, as the Mahabharata and Rāmāyaṇa.
 E. इतिह traditional
instruction, अस् to be, and घञ् aff.
